purpose: Reduced remote-player mesh (other players' look): same skeleton as the player, no clips, three draw calls, about 8.7k body triangles. Generated from the shipped player model; not a new character.

tool.stack: Node, @gltf-transform/core+extensions+functions 4.x (read/write/prune), meshoptimizer simplifier (simplifyWithAttributes, error cap 1, no border lock), sharp (texture decode only)
tool.settings: triangle budget 8700 split across the three groups in proportion to their source triangles; attribute weights normal .5 x3, colour 1 x3, skin weights 1 x4
steps: remove the weapon nodes (the kit equips the shared knife exactly as for the player)
merge the 15 per-mesh skins into one (they are identical: same joint names and inverse binds, checked by hash)
bake each vertex's base-colour (texture sampled bilinear at its UV, times the material factor) into COLOR_0; the Heraldry factor is not baked because the kit replaces it with the variant accent

group primitives into Skin (skin, face, head photo, leather, brass, steel), Gambeson (tunic, wraps) and Heraldry (skirt cloth); drop PhotoEyes and PhotoTeeth (about 2k triangles of eye/teeth overlays)
simplify each group's index buffer with meshoptimizer: vertices are kept, never moved, so every surviving vertex keeps its original joints and weights
compact the vertex buffers, drop UVs, tangents, textures and all clips, write GLB

verification.result: 65 joints: names, order, hierarchy, inverse binds identical; joint local TRS identical within 4.8e-6 (gltf-transform omits a bone scale within about 1e-5 of 1; the source has 0.99999988..0.999995 on thigh_l/r and thumb_02_l/r); all 7,361 surviving vertices match a source vertex on position + joints + weights (0 mismatches)
verification.clips: none shipped; the kit plays the player model's own clips (same joint names), so clip data is the untouched original
